description: This file defines a React functional component 'DeviceList' that manages and displays a list of devices, including functionalities such as loading devices, deleting, pinging, and refreshing the list, with UI elements like dialogs, loaders, and navigation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of devices from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the ID of the device to be deleted, triggering the confirmation dialog.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and executes the deletion of a device, updating the device list and UI accordingly.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Pings a device to check its status and updates the device list with the new status.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the device list from the API.
